# Pricing & Plans

## Chatty Plans & Pricing

**How much does Chatty cost? What is the price of the Pro plan / Basic plan / Plus plan?**

- **Free** — $0/month: 50 AI conversations/month (resets monthly), 200 products, 1 team member, 1 email channel, 90 days chat history, all channels & integrations.
- **Basic** — $19.99/month (or $16.99/month annual): 100 AI conversations/month + $0.40/extra, 500 products, 1,000 custom answers, 50 URLs & files, 5 team members, unlimited email channels, 12 months history, full chatbox customization.
- **Pro** — $68.99/month (or $58.99/month annual): 500 AI conversations/month + $0.40/extra, 8,000 products, unlimited custom answers, 500 URLs & files, 10 team members, unlimited history, full AI channels, full analytics.
- **Plus** — $199/month (or $169.99/month annual): 1,000 AI conversations/month + $0.40/extra, **Unlimited** products, unlimited custom answers, **Unlimited** URLs & files, unlimited team members, advanced analytics, dedicated AI consultant.
- **Enterprise** — Custom pricing for larger stores. Contact Chatty to build a custom plan.

---

## Plan Feature Comparison

**Free:** AI conversations 50/month (resets monthly), products 200, custom answers 100, URLs & files 20, team members 1, chat history 90 days, email channels 1, chatbox customization default.

**Basic:** AI conversations 100/month + $0.40/extra, products 500, custom answers 1,000, URLs & files 50, team members 5, chat history 12 months, email channels unlimited, chatbox customization full.

**Pro:** AI conversations 500/month + $0.40/extra, products 8,000, custom answers unlimited, URLs & files 500, team members 10, chat history unlimited, AI channels full, analytics full.

**Plus:** AI conversations 1,000/month + $0.40/extra, products **Unlimited**, custom answers unlimited, URLs & files **Unlimited**, team members unlimited, chat history unlimited, dedicated AI consultant included.

> **Since 23/06:** Plus product sync and URL/File upload were raised from 20,000/700 to **Unlimited**. If a merchant on Plus mentions hitting a product or URL/file cap, double-check they're actually on Plus — the cap they hit no longer exists on that plan.

**Two things can make a merchant's real limit differ from the table above:**

- **A negotiated limit.** Some stores have an AI conversation limit set individually for them. When
  the number in **Subscription → View details** disagrees with the plan table, the number in the app
  is the correct one — quote that, not the table.
- **Older Basic stores get 3 seats, not 5.** Stores that subscribed to Basic before January 2024 keep
  the original 3-seat allowance. Every other limit was raised for them; only the seat count stayed.

**Public API & webhooks — Pro/Plus only:**

| Plan | API key generation | Webhooks |
|---|---|---|
| Free | ✗ | ✗ |
| Basic | ✗ | ✗ |
| Pro | ✓ | ✓ |
| Plus | ✓ | ✓ |

A merchant on Free/Basic who wants to pull conversations via the API or forward chats to their own server must upgrade to **Pro or Plus** (see `faq_klaviyo` → *Chatty Public API & Webhooks*).

---

## Connecting Channels vs. AI Auto-Reply on Channels

Connecting a channel (Email, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram) to Chatty is available
on **all plans, including Free** — this only requires the channel Connect step under
**Settings → Channels**. What's plan-gated is **AI auto-reply** on WhatsApp,
Messenger, and Instagram, which requires **Pro or Plus** (see
`faq_ai-agent-settings` → *AI Channels*). A merchant asking "which plan do I need
for WhatsApp" usually means connecting it — that's free; only mention the Pro/Plus
requirement if they specifically want the AI answering on that channel.

---

## Free Trial & Refund Policy

**Free trial:** All paid plans include a **7-day free trial**. Cancel anytime during the trial.

**30-day Money Back Guarantee** applies when:
- You don't wish to continue after the first month
- You cancel before the first billing cycle ends
- You forgot to cancel the trial or accidentally chose a paid plan without using it in the first month

For a refund, contact support with a **screenshot of the Shopify charge** (showing app name, billing cycle, and amount).

---

## AI Conversation Limits

- **Free:** 50/month — resets monthly (no extra conversations available)
- **Basic:** 100/month — extra at $0.40/conversation
- **Pro:** 500/month — extra at $0.40/conversation
- **Plus:** 1,000/month — extra at $0.40/conversation

**When Free plan limit is reached:** The AI agent pauses for the rest of the month and the quota resets to 50 at the start of the next month. Conversations can still be handled manually in Inbox in the meantime.

**When paid plan limit is reached:** Extra conversations are charged at $0.40 each (unless a spending limit is set).

---

## Checking Usage & Setting a Spending Limit

**Check usage:**
1. Go to **Chatty → Subscription → View details**
2. Check **AI conversation** usage (conversations consumed this billing cycle)
3. Usage resets on your billing cycle date (not calendar month)
4. Email notifications sent at 80% and 100% of limit

**Set a spending limit:**
1. Go to **Chatty → Subscription → View details → Change limit**
2. Enter your budget limit → **Save**

Once the limit is reached, AI stops responding until the next billing cycle. Human agents can still handle conversations.

Tip: Set limit 15–20% above expected usage to handle busy periods.

---

## Extra Charges

Extra charges appear when AI conversations exceed your monthly plan limit — charged at **$0.40 per extra conversation**.

Set a spending cap via **Chatty → Subscription → View details → Change limit** to control this. Human agent responses have no per-conversation charge.

If you believe a charge was incorrect (e.g., system miscalculation), contact support with a **screenshot of the Shopify billing section** — the team will investigate and process a refund if the charge was an error.

---

## Charged Unexpectedly / Forgot to Cancel Trial

Chatty does not automatically upgrade plans. However, if you signed up for a paid trial and did not downgrade before the trial ended, Shopify charged you when the new cycle began.

**To stop future charges:** Go to **Chatty → Subscription → View plans** → select the **Free plan**.

**For a refund:** Contact support with a screenshot of the Shopify charge (showing app name, billing cycle, and amount) — the team will review and process a refund if applicable.

---

## Cancelling / Downgrading to Free

Go to **Chatty → Subscription → View plans** → select the **Free plan** → confirm.

Do this before your next billing cycle to avoid charges. Downgrading does not delete your data or settings.

---

## Applying a Discount Code

Go to **Chatty → Subscription** and enter the code in the **Discount Code** field before upgrading.

If the code shows as invalid, make sure you are on the correct plan (some codes are plan-specific). Contact support if the code still doesn't work.

---

## Annual Billing Discount

Save approximately **15%** by choosing annual billing:
- Basic: $16.99/month
- Pro: $58.99/month
- Plus: $169.99/month

---

## Bulk / Multi-Store Discount

A **20% lifetime bulk discount** is available for merchants running multiple stores:

- Applies to **monthly Pro or Plus** plans only.
- Requires **at least 2 stores on Pro or above** to qualify (they do **not** all need the same plan).
- **Not** available for the Basic plan.
- **Cannot** be combined with annual plans (annual already includes ~15–17% off). A store on annual must switch to monthly to use the bulk discount.

> Each store is billed separately by Shopify, so the discount code is applied per store. Collect the merchant's store count and current plans, then forward the request to the team — do not promise eligibility before confirming.

---

## Legacy Plan Price Changed

Contact support with a **screenshot of your Shopify billing history**. If you had an active discount or legacy pricing that should have been honored, the team can escalate to the billing team to review and restore your previous pricing. Refunds for the price difference can be requested if applicable.

---

## Shopify App Credits

Go to **Shopify Admin** → **Settings** → **Billing** → **App credits**. Credits appear here and can offset future app usage charges.

---

## Billing Date Format

Chatty uses **MM/DD/YYYY** format. "Renews on 04/12/2026" means **April 12, 2026** — not December 4.

---

## AI Scenario Limits

| Plan | Scenarios |
|------|-----------|
| Free / Basic | 5 |
| Pro | 15 |
| Plus | Unlimited |

Extensions beyond plan limits require PM approval. Contact support and explain your use cases — the more specific you are, the faster the request can be processed.

---

## Stores with 10,000+ Products

Yes, AI product recommendations work — but it requires manual backend configuration beyond the standard 5,000-product limit.

Contact support with your total product count and monthly order volume. For stores with 10,000+ products and 100+ orders/month, a demo call with the product team is recommended.

---

## Extending Plan Limits

Contact support and share what you need — the team will review and confirm if an extension is possible. Extensions up to the next plan's level are sometimes available as a one-time accommodation, subject to team approval.

Do not promise the merchant that an extension will be granted — collect the request and forward it to the team.

# Extend AI Training Data Limits (Products / Custom Answers / URL & File)

## Overview

CS can self-extend 3 types of AI training data limits — no escalation needed:
- **Products for AI training**
- **Custom Answers for AI training**
- **URL & File for AI training**

CS does **NOT** extend AI Conversations or AI Scenarios — those require PM approval via #sale-cs-success.

## Plan Limits Reference

| Feature | Free | Basic ($19.99) | Pro ($68.99) | Plus ($199) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Products for AI training | 200 | 500 | 8,000 | **Unlimited** |
| Custom Answers | 100 | 1,000 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| URL & File | 20 | 50 | 500 | **Unlimited** |

> **Updated 23/06:** Plus was raised from 20,000 products / 700 URL & File to **Unlimited** for both. A Plus merchant should never hit a Products or URL & File cap anymore — if they report one, check their plan is actually Plus before troubleshooting a "limit" (it may be a sync issue instead, see `case_ai-product-sync`).

---

## Resolution Steps

### Step 1 — Confirm the merchant's situation

Verify:
- What plan are they on? (Free / Basic / Pro / Plus)
- Which limit did they hit? (Products / Custom Answers / URL & File)
- How much do they need?

### Step 2 — Decide how much to extend

Extend up to the next plan's limit — **1 tier only, no more**.

| Merchant's plan | Products → extend to | Custom Answers → extend to | URL & File → extend to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Free | 1,500 (= Basic) | 5,000 (= Basic) | 200 (= Basic) |
| Basic | 8,000 (= Pro) | Unlimited (= Pro) | 2,000 (= Pro) |
| Pro | Unlimited (= Plus) | Already Unlimited | Unlimited (= Plus) |
| Plus | Already Unlimited — no extension needed | Already Unlimited | Already Unlimited — no extension needed |

### Step 3 — Have the extension applied

The merchant cannot raise their own limit from their settings — it is applied on our side. Hand the
request over with the store and the exact limit to raise, then confirm the change has taken effect
before telling the merchant it is done.

### Step 4 — Tag the conversation

Add tag **`extended-limit`** to the conversation in Crisp. Mandatory — do not skip.

### Step 5 — Confirm with merchant

> Great news! I've extended your [Products/Custom Answers/URL & File] limit so you can continue setting up your AI agent. You should now be able to [sync more products / add more custom answers / upload more files].
>
> Just so you know, if you need even more capacity in the future, upgrading to [next plan] would give you [limit of next plan] and also unlock [key feature of that plan]. Let me know if you need any help with that!

---

## Edge Cases

### Merchant requests multiple limits at once
Extend each limit type separately, all following the 1-tier rule. Have all the changes applied together, tag `extended-limit` once, confirm everything in a single message.

### Merchant has been extended before and comes back asking for more
This is a strong signal the merchant needs to upgrade. Push the upgrade clearly. If merchant still refuses → escalate to CSL. Do not extend again without CSL input.

### Merchant is on Free plan
Still extend up to Basic limits (same 1-tier rule). Make the extension but highlight the benefits of upgrading — the goal is to help them see Chatty's value and convert, not give unlimited free access.

### Merchant is on Plus and needs more than Plus limit
CS cannot self-extend beyond Plus limits. Escalate to PM via #sale-cs-success with: store URL, current plan, which limit is hit, and how much the merchant needs.

## Notes

- **Purpose of extending:** let the merchant experience enough value to upgrade on their own — not a permanent free pass.
- **Always tag `extended-limit`** after every extension — no exceptions.
- **Never extend AI Conversations or AI Scenarios** — those affect billing and product strategy, require PM approval.

# AI Product Sync Issues

## Product Sync Stuck

**First, collect from the merchant:**
- Store URL
- How long the sync has been stuck with no progress
- When the issue first started

1. Go to **AI agent** → **Training data** → **Products** and check the timestamp of the most recent sync
2. If sync has been running too long with no progress → the sync has to be reset and restarted from our side. Hand it over rather than telling the merchant to retry (warning: a reset restarts the sync from scratch)
3. After resync, update the merchant. When products are fully displayed, notify them
4. Advise the merchant not to make changes (editing product tags, etc.) during resync to avoid data conflicts

**If resync does not resolve it**, escalate to dev team with: store URL, sync timestamp, screenshot of stuck sync status.

---

## AI Not Syncing All Products

Only **published, in-stock** products are synced to the AI. Products sync daily at **00:00 UTC**.

Common causes:
- Products are in draft status or out of stock
- The merchant has hit their plan's product limit (Free: 200, Basic: 500, Pro: 8,000, Plus: **Unlimited** — raised from 20,000 on 23/06)
- Sync hasn't run yet after recent product changes

1. Check the merchant's plan and product count against the plan limit
2. Verify products are published and in stock in Shopify
3. Wait for the next daily sync or trigger a manual resync

**If issue persists after resync**, collect and escalate to dev team:
- Store URL
- Product count in Shopify vs. product count shown in AI
- Plan name
- Screenshot of sync status

---

## Deleted Products Still Showing in AI

**First, collect from the merchant:**
- Store URL
- Which product(s) are still appearing
- When they were deleted from Shopify

The sync may not immediately reflect product deletions.

1. Suggest the merchant trigger a manual resync in **AI agent → Training data → Products → Manage → Sync products**
2. Advise the merchant not to sync repeatedly — either sync manually once or rely on the daily auto-sync at 00:00 UTC
3. They can also **deactivate** the stale products in the Training data list (toggle them Disabled) so the AI stops using them immediately

**Deleted products reappearing after a manual resync is NOT expected behaviour.** If it keeps happening, escalate to the dev team with: store URL, an **example product** that keeps coming back, product name(s) still showing, deletion date, screenshot. The team can reset the sync from their side.

---

## Extending AI Training Data Limits

1. Check the merchant's current plan and what data type they need more of (Products/URLs/Files)
2. Explain plan limits and recommend an appropriate upgrade
3. If the merchant is not ready to upgrade → escalate internally to PM + CSL
4. For small increases (100–200 products, 10–20 URLs/Files) → the limit can be extended for them without requiring an upgrade
5. For stores with > 10,000 products → offer a demo call with the concerned team — requires manual backend configuration
6. Never promise beyond your authority — always say "I'll check internally" before confirming extensions

## Proactive Chat Overview

Proactive chat lets you send targeted messages to website visitors before they ask questions. Instead of waiting for customers to reach out, you can engage them at key moments in their shopping journey.

**Use cases:**
- Greet new visitors and guide them to products
- Recover abandoned carts with incentives
- Grow your email list with exclusive discount offers
- Recommend bestsellers when customers show buying intent

## Proactive Chat Templates

Chatty provides pre-built templates for common scenarios:

| Template | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Welcome visitors | Greet visitors with personalized messages to make them feel special |
| Subscribe newsletter | Capture customer email with hot deals, exclusive updates and rewards |
| Product recommendation | Boost sales by recommending hot-deals, cross-sell or upsell products |
| Cart booster | Convince customers to buy by offering them a small discount in the cart |
| Abandoned cart reminder | Encourage customers to complete their order after leaving items in cart. Since **07/08**, this popup shows in the **store's own language** instead of always English. |
| **View cart** | Sends a proactive message when a visitor views their cart page (default delay: **5 seconds**; max **1** View Cart message per session) |
| Collection boost | Boost sales when customers are browsing collection pages |
| Remove items from cart | Reassure customers when they remove items from the cart |
| Search page | Proactively guide users to search via the chatbot for more accurate results |

### Trigger Priority When Multiple Campaigns Qualify

If more than one proactive chat trigger is eligible to fire for the same visitor at the same time, only one shows — Chatty picks by this fixed priority order (highest first):

1. Cart Booster
2. Abandoned Cart
3. **View Cart**
4. Remove Items from Cart
5. Product
6. Collection
7. Search
8. Subscribe
9. Welcome

**View Cart will not show if Cart Booster already showed in the same session.** A visitor can still see multiple *different* proactive chats across a session — the cap is **max 5 proactive chats per session**, with only one shown at a time.

## Proactive Chat Analytics

The proactive chat dashboard shows performance metrics per campaign:
- **View** — number of times the campaign was shown to visitors
- **CTR** — click-through rate (clicks / views)
- **Revenue** — revenue attributed to the campaign
- **Order** — number of orders attributed to the campaign

Filter by date range and compare against a previous period. Campaigns can be sorted by Priority and filtered by Active / Inactive status.

## How to Set Up Proactive Chat

1. Go to **Proactive chat**
2. Click **Create proactive chat**
3. Choose your campaign type
4. Configure settings:

**Campaign details:**
- Campaign name
- Activate campaign toggle

**Targeting:**
- Trigger options: when to send the message
- Pages: which pages show this campaign (press Enter after each URL to add)
- Audience: all visitors or returning customers
- Devices: desktop, mobile, or both
- Display time: after page load, after scroll percentage, or after time delay
- Display duration: how long the campaign stays visible

**Message content:**
- Proactive message: text shown above the chatbox
- Rich content: include product suggestions (available for Product recommendations and Cart booster)
- Chat message: message sent when customers click the teaser (discount sent with message for Subscribe newsletter and Cart booster)

**Appearance** (colors are set per campaign, in the campaign editor — NOT in Chatbox → Appearance):
- Background color — pop-up background
- Text color — message text
- Button background color
- Button label color

Each has color presets plus a custom color picker. See the dedicated "Change proactive chat pop-up colors" chunk below.

5. Check **Preview** to see how the campaign looks on your storefront
6. Click **Activate** to make it live

## Campaign Priority

When multiple campaigns could show at the same time:
1. Highest priority campaigns show first
2. Multiple campaigns can display per visitor per session
3. Set priorities in campaign settings (1 = highest priority)

## Marketing Double Opt-In (Subscribe Newsletter)

When enabled, customers receive a confirmation email before getting their discount.

## Timing Best Practices

- Welcome messages: 5-10 seconds after page load
- Product recommendations: After 30-50% page scroll
- Cart boosters: 2-3 minutes after adding items to cart
- Newsletter signup: Before exit intent or after browsing multiple products

## Changing Proactive Chat Pop-up Colors

The color of a proactive chat pop-up (the teaser message that pops up, e.g. "You might like this product!") is set **per campaign**, inside the proactive chat campaign editor — **not** in Chatbox → Appearance. Chatbox → Appearance only controls the chatbox/widget itself; the pop-up has its own colors.

To change them:

1. Go to **Proactive chat** and open (or create) the campaign
2. Scroll to the **Appearance** section in the campaign editor
3. Set each color — choose a preset swatch or use the custom color picker (the pencil/rainbow swatch):
   - **Background color** — the pop-up's background
   - **Text color** — the message text
   - **Button background color** — the CTA button fill
   - **Button label color** — the CTA button text
4. Use the **Message Preview** panel on the right to see changes live
5. **Save / Activate** the campaign

> Each proactive chat campaign has its own Appearance colors, so different campaigns can use different color schemes.

## Automatic Message After Order Placement

At the moment, Chatty doesn't support sending an automatic message directly after a customer places an order.

However, as a workaround, you can set up a **Proactive Chat** trigger that activates when a customer visits the order confirmation page, and pair it with a **Custom AI Scenario** to send a personalized follow-up message.

For a more fully automated post-order workflow, consider integrating with **Klaviyo** to handle post-purchase email automation.

## Customizing Product Recommendation CTA Buttons

Yes, you can customize the CTA button when setting up a **Proactive Chat campaign** with product recommendations — for example, configuring buttons such as **Add to Cart** or **Learn More** that link customers to the product page. This is edited under **Message content → Chat message** in that campaign.

If you need more specific customization for these buttons, share how you'd like them to work and our team can check what's possible.

> **This only applies to Proactive Chat campaign buttons.** The CTA button on the AI's own **product recommendation card** — shown directly inside a chat conversation when the AI suggests a product, labeled **View Product** — is a fixed system button and is **not customizable**. Before answering "yes, customizable," confirm whether the merchant means a Proactive Chat popup campaign (customizable) or the AI's in-chat product card (not customizable, always "View Product").

This is usually not a bug — it means the wrong **template's message field** was configured for that campaign. For example, a campaign built from the **Cart booster** or **Subscribe newsletter** template carries its own discount-style message content, so if a merchant intended a plain greeting but picked (or later repurposed) one of those templates, the popup will show the discount copy instead.

**Fix:** open the campaign under **Proactive chat**, check the **Message content** section, and edit the **Proactive message** / **Chat message** fields directly to the intended text — no need to recreate the campaign from scratch.

## Does a Proactive Message Use Up an AI Conversation Credit?

No — showing a proactive message on its own does not consume an AI conversation. A conversation is only created (and counted against the plan's AI conversation limit) if the **customer replies** to the popup and the AI responds.

# Product Quiz

## What the Product Quiz Feature Is

Product Quiz is an **AI-powered, quiz-style product-recommendation flow** (shipped **01/08**): instead of the AI just answering a question, it asks the customer a short series of quiz questions first, then recommends products based on the answers. This is distinct from static product recommendations (recommendation cards/campaigns) since it's interactive and adapts to what the customer picks.

## Plan Availability

Product Quiz requires the **Pro or Plus** plan. On Free/Basic, merchants see an **upgrade button** instead of the quiz configuration — there's no way to preview or enable it below Pro.

## How to Enable and Configure It

1. Go to **AI agent → Instructions** and toggle on **Product Quiz** (it has its own separate configuration page, not just a toggle).
2. Set the **number of quiz questions**: choose **3, 5, or 7** questions. Default is **5 questions**.
3. Set how many products the AI recommends at the end: default is **2 products**.

## Common Questions

- **"Why can't I find Product Quiz settings?"** — confirm the store is on Pro or Plus first; on Free/Basic the setting is replaced by an upgrade prompt.
- **"How many questions does the quiz ask?"** — merchant-configurable at 3, 5, or 7; defaults to 5 if never changed.
- **"How is this different from the AI just recommending products in chat?"** — normal AI recommendations respond to what the customer already said; Product Quiz proactively asks a short structured Q&A first, which is useful for stores where the right product depends on several preferences (size, use case, budget, etc.).

For setup steps beyond what's covered here, escalate to support.

# Analytics

## Analytics Overview

Go to **Analytics** from the left sidebar. Has 5 tabs: **Overview, Human agent, AI agent, Sales, FAQs**.

Use the date range selector (e.g. Last 7 days) and **Compare to** previous period toggle at the top. Click **Reload** to refresh data.

**Report dates use the viewer's own browser timezone** — not the store's timezone and not UTC. If two team members in different timezones pull the same date range, their day boundaries (and therefore which conversations/orders fall into "today" vs "yesterday") can look different. This is expected — it's not a data discrepancy.

---

## What's Tracked

**What does AI Resolution Rate mean?** It measures the % of AI-handled conversations resolved without human intervention — found in **Analytics** → **AI agent** tab.

**What is Answer Rate?** It measures the % of customer messages the AI successfully answered — also in **Analytics** → **AI agent** tab.

**Overview tab:**
- Total conversations, Resolution rate, Chat-to-sales rate
- Assisted revenue (AOV)
- Total sales share contributed by Chatty
- **CSAT**: CSAT rate, Response rate, Average rating, Ratings count, Rating distribution
- **Conversations by channels**: Online store, Email, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp

**Human agent tab:**
- Total conversations, New conversations, Resolved conversations
- First response time, Handling time, Resolution time
- Charts: All vs resolved conversations over time, First response time over time, Handling time, Resolution time
- Team performance details — **staff activity/chat counts are tallied by number of reply instances (each individual reply a staff member sends), not by number of distinct conversations they touched.** A staff member who sends multiple replies in the same conversation will have each reply counted separately.

**AI agent tab:**
- **Overview**: AI involvement rate, AI resolution rate, Answer rate, Time saved
- **Customer feedback**: Total response, Great, Good, Bad
- Charts: AI involvement rate over time, AI resolution rate over time, Answer rate over time
- Common intents

**Sales tab (Chat-to-Sale report, added 01/07):**
The Sales tab has two sub-tabs:
- **Sales** — Total sales, Total store revenue share, Total orders, AOV, Conversion rate, **Top Products table** (Orders, Basket lift, Product revenue — per product, sortable), Charts: Total sales/orders/AOV/Conversion rate over time
- **Operations & Team** — open to **all plans**; only **4 extra columns** on this sub-tab require **Pro or Plus** (the sub-tab itself is not plan-gated, just those specific columns)
- **Extended/advanced columns on the Sales sub-tab also require the Pro or Plus plan** — merchants on the Free plan only see the basic columns.
- **Data runs in batches with roughly a 1-day delay** — if a merchant asks why today's sales/orders aren't showing yet in Analytics, that's expected, not a bug; it catches up within about a day.

**FAQs tab:**
- Published FAQs count, Total views
- Charts: FAQs views over time, Top viewed FAQs

---

## Staff Rankings

Chatty's **Analytics → Human agent** tab includes a staff ranking/leaderboard, **ranked by revenue contribution** — not by chat volume or number of conversations resolved.

---

## Metric Definitions & Common Discrepancies

Merchants often flag these numbers as "wrong" — they're usually just narrower definitions than expected:

- **Handled Conversations** counts only replies made **within 24 hours** of the customer's message. A reply to an older backlog message isn't counted, so this figure can read lower than the merchant's actual workload.
- **First Response Time** is a median across conversations that received a **human** reply — automated (AI) replies and stale backlog replies are excluded.
- **Total conversations showing 0** almost always means the **Live chat** block is off (**Chatbox → General → Blocks**) — with it off, no conversations can be created at all. See `case_chatbox-widget-issues` / `faq_chatbox-settings` for the fix.
- **Conversations marked as spam/blocked are excluded from all analytics metrics** — they don't inflate conversation counts, response-time stats, or any other figure on these tabs. If a merchant expects a number to be higher because of spam traffic they've blocked, this is why it isn't.
- **Basket lift** (Sales tab → Top Products table) is a **per-product** metric: the **average value of the whole order** a product appeared in — not the product's own price. The **uplift %** shown next to it compares that average order value against the product's own median unit price, so it reflects how much extra (cross-sell/upsell) customers tend to buy alongside that specific product. It is not a store-wide "AOV of chat users vs non-chat users" figure — don't describe it that way.

If numbers still don't reconcile after checking these definitions, ask for the store URL and the period in question — there have been genuine backend counting issues (including CSAT ratings not recording) that required a platform-side fix.

---

## Verifying Assisted Revenue & Order Attribution

Chatty tags attributed orders in **Shopify** with one of two order tags:
- **`chatty-assisted`** — the customer interacted with Chatty and then placed the order
- **`chatty-direct`** — the order came directly through the Chatty conversation

**To verify the revenue side:** open **Analytics → Overview** (assisted revenue / AOV, total sales share contributed by Chatty) and **Analytics → Sales** (total sales, orders, conversion rate). These are the numbers to reconcile against.

> **A tagged order will not always map 1:1 to a named contact in the Inbox.** Many attributed sessions are anonymous, so the buyer's email won't appear on the conversation. Reconcile via **Analytics**, not by searching the Inbox for the buyer's email — searching the Inbox by email is the most common wrong turn here.

---

## Why Did My Revenue / Order Numbers Change? (Aug 2026 Attribution Updates)

Several changes shipped between **31/07 and 06/08** to how Chatty calculates Sales-tab numbers. These are **methodology corrections, not data loss or a bug** — if a merchant's numbers moved (up or down) around this window and they ask why, check this list first before escalating.

**Order attribution window shortened to 7 days (06/08):** an order now only counts as attributed to a conversation if it was placed within **7 days** of the customer's last message in that conversation. Some stores will see order/revenue counts drop after this date — this is a correction to reduce over-attribution of very old conversations to recent orders, not missing data.

**Fully-refunded/cancelled orders excluded from attributed revenue (31/07):** applies to the Chatty-assisted revenue card, funnel table, topic table, and daily chart on **Analytics → Sales**. All plans affected.
- **Order count is unchanged** — only the revenue figure drops, so conversion rate is unaffected.
- Measured across 2,741 stores over 90 days: median revenue impact **~0%**, top 10% of stores saw **-4% to -10%**.
- **Partial refunds are not yet excluded** — only fully-refunded/cancelled orders.

**Funnel table now includes orders outside the viewed date range (31/07):** the funnel table now counts an order as long as the **order itself** falls in the selected date range, even if the linked **conversation** happened outside that range. This makes the funnel table match the top-of-page metric cards (which worked this way already). Order counts in the funnel table can jump noticeably after this change:
- 7-day filter: 74/77 affected stores saw a median **+21.6%** in previously-missed orders (max +75.4%)
- 30-day filter: 216/317 affected stores saw a median **+3.2%**

Available to **paid plans viewing the full funnel**.

**Product revenue now nets out discounts (31/07):** the **Top Products** table on Analytics → Sales (Pro & Plus) now shows product revenue **after discounts**, instead of at list price. Orders recorded **before** this date keep their old list-price numbers — they are not retroactively recalculated. If a merchant compares two periods spanning this date, product revenue will look like it dropped starting from this point — that's the calculation change, not fewer sales.

**Plan-tier locks now enforced in exports, not just the UI (23/07):** previously, a Free/Basic merchant exporting from Analytics → Sales could still get Pro/Plus-only columns in the raw export even though they were blurred on screen. Exports now strip that data server-side, matching what the UI shows. Affects: funnel table, topic table, detail panel, Top Products, staff table, and the full Operations & Team sub-tab. If a merchant on a lower plan says "my export used to have more columns," this is why — full funnel needs a paid plan, and topic table/detail panel/Top Products/full Operations & Team need Pro & Plus.

**Cross-sell block replaced by Top Products chart (08/07):** the old **Cross-sell block** on Analytics → Sales (Pro & Plus) was removed and replaced with a **Top Products chart ranked by AOV**. If a merchant who's used to the Cross-sell block asks where it went, explain it was replaced — it isn't coming back, the new Top Products chart is the equivalent.

---

## Chat Revenue Written Directly to Shopify Orders & Customers (30/07)

Chat-attributed revenue data is now written directly onto the **Shopify Order** and **Customer** records themselves — not just visible inside Chatty's own Analytics. This lets a merchant filter/segment **directly in Shopify Admin**:
- **Shopify Admin → Orders** — filter orders by chat-attributed revenue data
- **Shopify Admin → Customers** — segment customers using the same data

Available on **all plans**. Two caveats to check before promising this works:
- Some stores in an early test cohort haven't had this enabled yet.
- The order field requires the store to have granted Chatty **order-write permission** — if a merchant doesn't see the data on Shopify orders, check whether that permission scope was granted during install/reauthorization.

# AI Wrong Responses

## AI Not Responding at All

Ask the merchant to check in this order:

1. **Verify AI agent is enabled** — toggle must be ON in AI agent settings
2. **Check plan's AI conversation limit:**
   - Free plan = 50 conversations/month (resets monthly) — when hit, AI pauses until the next cycle
   - Paid plans = monthly quota; when quota is exhausted AI stops until billing reset
   - Guide merchant to upgrade or wait for monthly reset if limit is the cause
3. **Check training data is added and synced** — AI cannot reply if no data sources are active
4. **Ensure Live Chat block is enabled** — go to **Chatbox → General → Blocks** → enable **Live chat**

> ⚠️ Check plan limits **first** — this is the most common cause for AI suddenly stopping.

**If none of the above resolves it**, collect and escalate to the team:
- Store URL
- When the AI stopped responding (approximate date/time)
- Which of the above steps were already checked
- Screenshot of AI agent settings showing the toggle state and plan usage

---

## AI Hallucinating / Over-Promising

**Step 1 — Collect from the merchant:**
- Conversation ID, or customer name/email in that chat
- What the customer asked
- What the AI promised or said (exact wrong answer)
- What the correct response should have been
- Whether this has happened more than once / with multiple customers

**Step 2 — Guide merchant to check Review Sources (do this while escalating):**
- Open the conversation → find the wrong AI reply → click **Review Sources**
- Ask: *"Does any source shown mention refunds/returns, or is there no source at all?"*
- No source shown = likely hallucination; source shown = training data may contain incorrect info

**Step 3 — Escalate to CS** with all collected info + Review Sources findings.

**Immediately suggest a temporary instruction to prevent recurrence:**
- Go to **AI agent → Instructions → Manage → Assistant skills → Custom scenarios** → add scenario with keywords: "refund", "return", "replacement"
- Instruction: *"Ask the customer for photos and direct them to support email instead of promising any action."*

> Known limitation — the AI may over-promise based on general knowledge if not explicitly restricted via instructions.

---

## AI Mentioned a Wrong Discount or Promotion

**Step 1 — Collect from the merchant:**
- Conversation ID, or customer name/email in that chat
- What the customer asked
- What discount the AI mentioned (e.g. "30% off", specific promo code)
- Whether this discount exists or has existed anywhere (active promo, old campaign, etc.)
- Whether this has happened more than once / with multiple customers

**Note:** Chatty automatically syncs promotion data from the store. The AI may be pulling a real (but outdated or unintended) discount from synced data — this is not always a hallucination.

**Step 2 — Guide merchant to check Review Sources (do this while escalating):**
- Open the conversation → find the wrong AI reply → click **Review Sources**
- Ask: *"Is there a source shown that mentions this discount? Or no source at all?"*
- Source shown with discount info = synced data issue; no source = hallucination

**Step 3 — Escalate to CS** with all collected info + what the merchant saw in Review Sources.

**While waiting for CS to investigate**, suggest the merchant add a temporary instruction:
- Go to **AI agent → Instructions → Manage → Assistant skills → Custom scenarios** → add scenario with keywords: "discount", "promo", "coupon", "% off"
- Instruction: *"Do not confirm or offer any discounts or promotions. If a customer asks, direct them to [support contact] to check current offers."*

> If the merchant recently ran a promotion and removed it from Shopify, a manual resync in **AI agent → Training data → Manage → Products** may be required for the AI to stop referencing it.

## AI Misreads Store Page Layout — Comparison Tables, Strikethrough Pricing

**Known limitation:** the AI reads page content as text and does not reliably interpret visual formatting like **strikethrough**, or which **column/row** a table value belongs to. Two recurring patterns:

- **Comparison tables (e.g. a spec table with checkmarks per product column):** if a merchant's page compares multiple products/models in a table, the AI can attribute a checkmark or feature to the wrong column/product — it read the row text correctly but matched it to the wrong product name.
- **Strikethrough / "compare at" pricing:** when a price on the page has strikethrough styling (e.g. a crossed-out MSRP shown next to the real price, or a "Deposit-only" label that isn't carried over as plain text), the AI can't detect the strikethrough and may read the crossed-out number as if it were the active, full price.

**What to do:**
1. Confirm via **Review Sources** on the wrong reply — the AI is usually quoting real page content, just misattributed or missing its formatting context, not fabricating a number.
2. Give the merchant/customer the accurate figure or comparison for that conversation.
3. **Workaround for the merchant:** add an explicit Q&A under **AI agent → Training data → Custom knowledge** stating the correct fact in plain text (e.g. "$6,999 is a deposit-only price, not the full MSRP" or "Feature X is available on the Pro model, not the base model"). A plain-text Q&A gives the AI an unambiguous source instead of the raw page layout.
4. This is a **known AI limitation with visual formatting/table structure**, not a data-sync issue — don't send the merchant to re-sync products or pages, that will not fix it.

---

## AI No Longer Invents Store Policy When It Doesn't Know (Fixed 13/08)

**Old behavior:** if the AI couldn't find return/shipping/warranty policy info in the shop's trained content, it would sometimes **invent a plausible-sounding but fake policy** instead of saying it didn't know — this was the direct cause of most "AI answered my policy wrong" complaints.

**Fixed 13/08:** when the AI can't find the relevant policy in the shop's content, it now says so plainly and offers a **human handover**, instead of guessing or fabricating an answer.

**What this means for CS:**
- If a merchant reports the AI stated an incorrect return/shipping/warranty policy **after 13/08**, first check whether the correct policy is actually present and enabled in the AI's training data (Training data → FAQs/Custom knowledge/synced Shopify policy pages) — a wrong answer post-fix is much more likely a **missing/incomplete data source** than fabrication.
- If the AI is saying "I don't have that information" for a policy that IS in the training data, treat it as a retrieval issue (see `AI Says "We Don't Have Information"` above), not related to this fix.

---

## AI Reverts to Default Behavior

Ask the merchant to check in this order:

1. **Check Instructions are saved** — not just edited; confirm the save button was clicked after changes
2. **Verify data sources are still active** — go to **AI agent → Training data → Manage** and check that Q&A entries and URL sources have not been accidentally disabled
3. **Review Scenario keywords** — make sure keywords are specific enough to trigger correctly; overly broad keywords may fail to match

**If the above steps don't fix it**, collect and escalate to the team:
- Store URL
- Description of what reverted (which instruction or behavior)
- When it started happening
- Confirmation that instructions were saved and data sources are active

---

## AI Correct in Test AI But Wrong on the Live Site

The most common cause: **a live chat session holds the knowledge it loaded when the conversation started.** If a customer opened the chat before the merchant's training-data change, that session keeps answering from the old data even after the fix.

1. **Ask the merchant which exact question/message they used to test** — get the specific wording so the case can be reproduced before proposing a fix.
2. Ask the merchant (or reproduce yourself) to **Reset the conversation** on the storefront, then ask the same question again.
3. This resolves the vast majority of these reports.

**If a freshly reset conversation still differs from Test AI**, that's not expected — escalate with: the exact question, a screenshot of the live wrong answer, and the **Review Sources** output from that live answer. This retrieval-difference class of bug has open investigations with the dev team.

---

## AI Giving Wrong Answers — General Diagnostic Flow

**Step 1 — Collect from the merchant:**
- What the AI said (wrong or incomplete answer)
- What the correct answer should be
- Conversation ID, or the customer's name/email in that chat
- Whether this has happened more than once / with multiple customers

**Step 2 — Guide merchant to check Review Sources (do this while escalating):**
- Open the conversation → find the wrong AI reply → click **Review Sources**
- Ask the merchant: *"What sources are shown? Do they look correct or outdated?"*

This helps identify the root cause immediately without waiting for CS:

| What's seen in Review Sources | Root cause | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Source data is incorrect or outdated | Bad training data | Update/correct the source content |
| Source is correct but AI misinterprets | Ambiguous wording | Rephrase or add more detail to the FAQ/scenario |
| Wrong source was pulled | Overlapping content | Merge or differentiate FAQs → see *Mixed FAQs* below |
| No sources shown | Possible hallucination | Check if Training Data was synced; escalate to dev if empty |
| Instructions conflict with source | Bad instruction override | Review Custom Instructions and Scenario Instructions |

**Step 3 — Escalate to CS** with all collected info above + what the merchant saw in Review Sources, so CS can investigate in parallel.

**While waiting for CS**, suggest the merchant use **Test AI** to reproduce the issue and note exactly what response comes back.

## AI Says "We Don't Have Information" Despite Data Being Added/Synced

> **Check first:** if the failing question contained a **translated / market-domain product URL** (e.g. a `.pl` or `.fr` storefront link), stop here — see *AI Can't Find a Product from a Translated / Market Domain URL* below. The sync is fine; the URL format is what breaks the lookup.

The AI replies *"I don't have that information"* / *"we don't have details on that"* for a topic
(discounts, products, markets, FAQs...) **even though** the merchant has added the data and run a sync.

> ⚠️ Most common cause: the **training source toggle for that topic is OFF**. Syncing data and *enabling*
> the AI to use it are **two separate steps**. If the toggle is off, the AI ignores that source entirely
> even when the data is fully synced. Always check the toggle before escalating.

**Step 1 — Identify which source the question belongs to:**
Ask the merchant which kind of question the AI couldn't answer, and map it to a Training data tab:
- Discount / promo / coupon question → **Discounts** tab
- Product question → **Products** tab
- Collection question → **Collections** tab
- Market / regional pricing question → **Markets** tab
- Policy / how-to / general question → **FAQs** or **Custom knowledge** tab

**Step 2 — Check the source's enable toggle (do this first):**
- Go to **AI agent → Training data → [the matching tab]**
- Confirm the **"Enable your AI agent to answer customer questions about [topic]"** toggle is **ON**
- Example: on the **Discounts** tab, the toggle next to *"Enable your AI agent to answer customer questions about discounts"* must be on — if it is off, the AI will say it has no discount information even with discounts synced.

**Step 3 — Confirm the data actually loaded:**
- On the same tab, check the **"X [items] learned"** badge — if it shows **0**, the data is not in yet.
- Check **Last updated** — if it shows **N/A**, no sync has ever run.
- Click **Sync now** and wait for it to finish, then confirm the count is greater than 0.

**Step 4 — Re-test:**
- Use **AI agent → Test AI → Test now** and ask the same question. With the toggle ON and the count > 0, the AI should now answer.

**Step 5 — If the toggle is ON, count > 0, and it still says no information:**
- Guide the merchant to open the chat → click **Review Sources** on the failed reply — if no source is shown, escalate.
- Escalate to CS with: store URL, which Training data tab, screenshot showing the toggle ON + the "X learned" count, the exact question asked, and the Test AI result.

## Chatty and Shopify Markets

Yes — Chatty supports Shopify Markets. Enable **Sync Markets** in **AI agent** → **Training data → Manage → Markets** to sync market-specific pricing and domains. Without this setting, the AI may show main-domain prices instead of market-specific prices.

**Testing a market before it's live:** merchants can preview a market's language/currency setup on a **draft (unpublished) theme** in the Shopify theme editor — it doesn't need to be published/live to test.

If the AI is already showing wrong prices or wrong domain links for a market, see the troubleshooting entries below.

- What the correct price should be for that market

**Step 4 — If all settings are correct but issue persists:**
- Follow collaborator access flow (`ref_collaborator-access.md`) — escalate to dev team with: which market domain, incorrect price shown, screenshot of Shopify Market pricing, collaborator code (or screenshots only if merchant declines)

## AI Showing Main Domain Instead of Market Domain

**Fixed 06/08 — this is no longer a known limitation.** AI reply links now keep the **correct market domain**: for multi-market stores, links in AI replies match the domain the customer is currently viewing, applied automatically. If a merchant on a store with 2+ markets reports the AI is still showing the main-domain link instead of their market domain, do **not** default to the old "known limitation / not yet supported" answer below — treat it as a new bug and escalate.

**Two tiers of accuracy:**
- **Basic tier** (works on its own) — correct market link if the chat widget sends the market code, or if the page URL itself indicates the market.
- **Country-detection tier** (needs **Pro or Plus**) — Chatty detects the visitor's market by geo/browser signal even without an explicit market code or URL hint.

**Per-market settings (since 04/08):** stores with 2+ markets get a **Markets** section under **Settings → Chat appearance**, with a **Manage** button for per-market overrides. Since 04/08 this also includes overriding the **AI assistant name** and **store name** per market, not just links.

**If a merchant still reports a wrong domain after 06/08:**
1. Confirm the store actually has **2+ Shopify Markets** configured (Shopify Admin → Markets) — this feature only applies to genuine multi-market stores.
2. Confirm which tier applies (does the widget/URL carry a market signal, or is this relying on country-detection, which needs Pro/Plus).
3. Collect: conversation ID, the wrong link shown, the expected market domain, and the merchant's plan — escalate to the team.

## AI Can't Find a Product from a Translated / Market Domain URL

**Symptom (pre-06/08 behavior):** On a multi-market or multi-language store, the AI answered *"no information found"* for a product when the question contained a **translated or market-specific domain URL** (e.g. a `.pl` or `.fr` storefront link) — even though the product was Active and synced. Searching by **product name or SKU** in the same chat returned the product fine.

**Status: fixed as part of the 06/08 market-domain update.** AI replies now resolve and generate links against the visitor's current market domain (see *AI Showing Main Domain Instead of Market Domain* above), so lookups keyed off a market/translated-domain URL should no longer fail this way. If a merchant reports this symptom on a chat from **after 06/08**, don't assume it's this known (now-fixed) issue — collect the details below and escalate as a fresh case.

> Do NOT route this to the training-source/sync checks (see *AI Says "We Don't Have Information"*) — this was never a sync problem, and post-fix, a genuine recurrence needs direct escalation, not a resync.

**Workaround still valid if it recurs:**
- Reference products by **name or SKU** in customer conversations instead of pasting the translated-domain URL.

**If it recurs, escalate to the team with:**
- Both store URLs (main domain + the translated/market domain)
- The product name and SKU
- An example of the failing question, exactly as asked
- The date/time of the conversation (needed to confirm whether this predates or postdates the 06/08 fix)

## Why a Product Card Appears (or Doesn't) — Product Accuracy Rule

**The rule:** the AI only shows a product card for a product it specifically **mentioned in its own written response** — not for products that are merely related, browsed, or pulled in through some other association.

This matters when triaging a "wrong product shown" or "extra product card" case:
- If the card shown matches a product the AI's text actually named, that's **expected behavior**, even if the merchant expected a different/related product to show instead.
- If the card shown does **not** match anything the AI's text mentioned, that's genuinely unexpected — treat it like the other product-accuracy cases above (wrong/foreign/deleted product) and collect Conversation ID, the AI's exact text, and the product card shown, then check **Review Sources** before escalating.

## AI Transferring Without Being Asked

**First, collect from the merchant:**
- Conversation ID, or customer name/email in that chat
- What the customer said that triggered the transfer
- What should have happened instead

**Step 1 — Review Human Handover auto triggers:**
- Go to **AI agent** → **Instructions** → **Manage** → **Assistant skills** → **Customer support skills** → **Human handover**
- Under "When should AI hand off to your team?", check the **Auto triggers**:
  - "Customer asks to talk to a person" is `Always on` and can't be disabled
  - Turn OFF the ones causing unintended escalation — common culprits: **AI cannot answer** (fires after 2 low-confidence replies), **Customer repeats question** (fires when same question asked 2+ times), **Negative sentiment** (fires on frustration/anger, ALL CAPS, negative emojis, or 2+ thumb-down reactions)

**Step 2 — Review Intent rules:**
- Check the **Intent rules** the merchant defined — these transfer immediately on a semantic match with no AI response first
- Remove or narrow any rule whose topic is too broad

**Step 3 — Check Automation rules:**
- Go to **Automation settings** → check if any rule is set to auto-assign or transfer conversations
- If **Automatic assignment** is on, it may transfer when broad conditions are met — tighten them

**If issue persists after adjusting triggers and automation:**
- Gather: example chat link where unintended transfer happened, screenshot of current trigger settings
- Escalate with those details

## AI Add-to-Cart Issues

**There is NO merchant self-serve add-to-cart toggle.** Add-to-cart is automatic behavior of the AI product assistant — when a customer asks in chat, the AI adds the item to the cart. Do not tell the merchant to look for a toggle under AI agent → Settings; no such option exists there. If the AI is not adding items, it is a theme-compatibility or product/variant issue, not a setting — diagnose below.

**If the merchant wants add-to-cart turned OFF entirely** (e.g. a store whose goal is appointment bookings rather than direct sales, or the AI is adding to cart against instructions on ambiguous replies): this can't be self-served, but the backend team can disable AI add-to-cart features for that account on request — escalate with the store URL and reason. For only-ambiguous-reply cases, a **custom scenario** that confirms purchase intent before acting is usually a better fix than disabling the feature outright.

**Step 1 — Identify what's failing:**
- Product not added at all, vs. added but cart count doesn't update, vs. fails only for products with multiple variants ("couldn't identify the variant").

**Step 2 — Test on storefront:**
- Ask the merchant: "What theme are you using?"
- Some themes (especially heavily customized or headless themes) don't support Chatty's cart integration
- Test on the live storefront — does the cart count update after AI adds a product?

**Step 3 — Cart count not updating vs. product not added:**
- If product is in cart but count doesn't update → theme rendering issue; refreshing page is the workaround
- If product is NOT in cart at all → likely a theme compatibility issue
- If it fails only for products with **multiple variants** (AI says it can't identify the variant, or claims it added but cart stays empty) → variant-matching limitation; collect the chat ID + product example and escalate to the team

**Step 4 — If theme compatibility confirmed as the issue:**
- Follow collaborator access flow (`ref_collaborator-access.md`) — escalate to TS with: theme name and version, specific product tested, screenshot showing cart before/after, collaborator code (or without code if merchant declines; TS will provide manual fix instructions based on theme name)

## HTML Showing in Chat Responses

**First, collect from the merchant:**
- Conversation ID, or customer name/email in that chat
- Screenshot or copy of the response showing raw HTML
- What the response should look like

**Step 1 — Find the source of HTML:**
- Go to **AI agent → Training data → Manage → FAQs** and **Custom scenarios** → open each entry relevant to the affected topic
- Look for `<div>`, `<p>`, `<br>`, `<strong>`, `<ul>` tags — these will be returned as raw text by the AI

**Step 2 — Clean the training data:**
- Remove all HTML tags and replace with plain text or markdown equivalents:
  - `<strong>text</strong>` → `**text**`
  - `<br>` → new line
  - `<ul><li>` → `- item`
  - `<p>` → remove, just use line breaks

**Step 3 — Save and verify:**
- Save changes and use **Test AI** with the same question
- If HTML still appears → check Custom Instructions for any HTML content as well

**Step 4 — If HTML is not in training data but still appearing:**
- This may be a rendering bug — gather: screenshot of the raw HTML in chat, which question triggered it, Test AI screenshot
- Escalate to dev team

## AI Mixing Up Similar FAQs

**Step 1 — Collect from the merchant:**
- Conversation ID, or customer name/email in that chat
- What the AI said (wrong answer)
- What the correct answer should be

**Step 2 — Guide merchant to check Review Sources (do this while escalating):**
- Open the conversation → find the wrong AI reply → click **Review Sources**
- Ask: *"Are there multiple sources shown? Do they seem to be about similar topics?"*
- Multiple overlapping sources = the AI is pulling the wrong one

**Step 3 — Escalate to CS** with collected info + Review Sources findings.

**While investigating, guide merchant to fix the conflicting entries:**

**Step 4 — Identify and fix the conflicting entries:**
- Go to **AI agent → Training data → Manage → FAQs**
- Search for the topic keywords — find the two (or more) entries that overlap

| Situation | Fix |
|---|---|
| Two entries cover the same topic | Merge into one comprehensive entry |
| Two policies that are genuinely different | Make trigger keywords more specific and non-overlapping |
| One entry is outdated | Delete the old one, keep only the updated one |

**Step 2 — Make trigger keywords distinct:**
- Each FAQ should have unique trigger keywords that don't appear in the other entry
- Avoid generic keywords like "shipping" or "return" — be specific: "international shipping" vs "domestic return policy"

**Step 3 — Verify:**
- Use **Test AI** with the exact customer question — check **Review Sources** to confirm it now pulls only the correct entry

**If the issue persists after cleanup**, collect and escalate to the team:
- Store URL
- The two conflicting FAQ entries (titles or content)
- Screenshot of Review Sources showing the wrong entry being pulled

## AI Not Transferring When Asked

**First, collect from the merchant:**
- Conversation ID, or customer name/email in that chat
- Exact phrase the customer used to request a human
- What the AI responded instead of transferring

**Step 1 — Check Human Handover settings:**
- Go to **AI agent** → **Instructions** → **Manage** → **Assistant skills** → **Customer support skills** → **Human handover**
- The "Customer asks to talk to a person" trigger is `Always on` — AI detects intent like "talk to human", "speak to agent", "real person". This cannot be disabled, so an explicit human request should always transfer.

**Step 2 — Check the destination ("Where does the customer go?"):**
- If set to **Collect info & follow up by email** or **Show contact methods**, the customer won't be live-transferred to the inbox — they'll be asked for email / shown contact options instead. Switch to **Transfer to human in Chatty inbox** if the merchant expects a live agent.

**Step 3 — Check offline behavior:**
- If "While the customer waits, let AI keep replying" is set to **Allow only outside business hours** or **Allow all the time**, the AI keeps answering instead of handing off when the team is offline — this is expected.
- Check working hours in **Chat availability settings**.

**Step 4 — Check language:**
- If the merchant's customers write in another language, confirm the intent is still detected — escalate with the exact phrase if a clear human request in another language was missed.

**Step 5 — If handover is configured correctly but still not triggering:**
- Gather: exact phrase the customer used, chat link, screenshot of current Human handover settings
- Escalate with those details — may need a prompt-level fix

# General Settings

## Settings Overview

**Settings** is accessed from the left sidebar in Chatty. It has 7 tabs:

| Tab | What's in it |
|---|---|
| **General** | Embed app, Language, Store information (name + avatar), Chat availability, Reports, Font, Date format, Manage keys (API) |
| **Inbox settings** | Message preference (Enter key behavior), Quick replies, Anonymous visitor names |
| **Automation** | Assignment method, Automatic resolution, Satisfaction survey, Spam protection |
| **Channels** | Email, WhatsApp, Messenger / Instagram |
| **Integrations** | Joy, Zendesk, Gorgias, Klaviyo, Order Tracking, Website Integration, Shopify Flow, Powerful contact form |
| **Team** | Invite and manage team members |
| **Notifications** | Notification triggers, Sound settings, Notification types (Email, Web push, Mobile app) |
| **Translations** | Add and manage languages for chatbox content |

---

## Change Store Name and Avatar

1. Go to **Settings** → **General** → **Store information**
2. Update the **Name** field
3. Upload or remove the **Avatar** image
4. Save

The store name and avatar are shown in conversations with customers.

## Automation Settings

Go to **Settings** → **Automation**.

**Assignment:**
- **Manual assignment** — team manually picks up conversations
- **Automatic assignment in order** — conversations auto-assigned to team members in rotation
  - Assign to: All members or Specific members
  - Option: Only assign to online members
  - Reassign based on replies: stay with assigned member, or reassign to whoever replies

**Automatic resolution:**
- **On by default at 60 minutes** — auto-closes a conversation that has had no team message for that long
- Configure: number + unit (minutes, hours, or days — the default unit is minutes)
- Customize the notice message shown at end of conversation
- Toggle it off if the store does not want conversations closing themselves

**Satisfaction survey:**
- Click **Manage** to configure. Options:
  - **Display**: toggle on/off
  - **Survey format**: Star rating or Emoji scale
  - **Survey content**: customize Intro text and Thank you message
  - **Trigger time**: send when Conversation is resolved, and/or when specific keywords appear in conversation (e.g. "Thank you", "Thanks", "Got it", "That helps", "Perfect")

**Spam protection:**
- Toggle **Smart spam protection** to have Chatty automatically **classify and flag** suspected spam, sexual, hateful, or violent messages for merchant review.
- **As of 14/08, suspected-spam messages are flagged only, not auto-blocked by default.** The conversation still runs and the customer still gets a response — flagging just surfaces it for the merchant to review, so real customers who were previously false-positived as spam are no longer shut out.
- **Merchants who want the old auto-block behavior can opt in** to blocking flagged conversations — this is a separate choice from the default flag-only behavior. If a merchant asks "why isn't spam being blocked anymore," this is the answer: the default changed, but blocking is still available as an opt-in.

## Team Members

Go to **Settings** → **Team**.

- Click **Invite member** to add a new team member by email
- View all members with: Name, Email, Member since, Role, Status
- Pro plan supports up to 10 members — upgrade to get more seats

---

## Notification Settings

Go to **Settings** → **Notifications**.

**Notification triggers** (toggle Web and/or Email per trigger):
- Conversation assigned to me
- New message in conversations assigned to me
- Someone mentions me in a conversation
- New message from unassigned conversations
- New unassigned conversation from AI
- Conversation assigned to another member
- New message in a conversation assigned to another member
- New message from AI conversations
- No reply 15 minutes in my conversations (Reminder)

**Which of these are on to begin with:** everything about *your own* conversations, unassigned
conversations and the 15-minute reminder. Anything about **another member's conversations** and
about **conversations handled by the AI** starts **off**. A member who says they get no alerts for
those is seeing it work as designed, not a fault — they just need to switch the trigger on.

**Alerts are not instant.** There is a short buffer of about a minute before one is sent, so that a
customer typing several messages in a row produces one alert instead of five. A delay of roughly a
minute is normal and is not a sign of anything broken.

**Sound settings:**
- Toggle on to play sound for new messages
- Choose: Only first message, or All messages

> **Sound only plays in the active browser tab.** If Chatty is open in a background
> (inactive) browser tab, the notification sound will not play — even with sound
> settings toggled on. This is a common cause of "I stopped hearing notification
> sounds" reports: the fix is to keep the Chatty tab active/focused, or rely on Web
> push / mobile app notifications instead for background alerts.

**Notification types:**
- **Email** — manage or send test
- **Web push** — browser notifications; manage or send test
- **Chatty mobile app** — download the app to receive notifications on mobile

> **Notification settings are per member account, not global.** Turning everything off on the admin account does not silence other team members — each member must turn their own triggers off.

---

## Which Email Receives Chats (and How to Change It)

Two different addresses — don't confuse them:

- **Admin account email** — the account that logs into Chatty. To switch it to a different address (e.g. `support@`), the merchant shares the address they want and **our team changes it**; a verification code is sent to the new address. On **Free / single-seat plans the existing account can only be replaced, not added to**. See `case_email-channel-issues` → *Changing Admin Email*.
- **Notification email** — where alerts are sent. Set in **Settings → Notifications**, and for AI/contact-form emails in **AI agent → Settings → Contact support email**.

---

## Translations

Go to **Settings** → **Translations**.

- View **Language usage** (e.g. 2/10) and **Auto-translate usage** (e.g. 0/9)
- Click **Add language** to add a new language
- Languages are shown as **Published** (visible to customers) or **Unpublished**
- Edit translations using the pencil icon, or use the "..." menu for more options
- English is always the Default language

---

## Disclaimer Consent

Disclaimer consent adds your privacy policy link under the email collection form. Configured in **Chatbox** → **Chat page** → **Pre-chat form** → **Disclaimer consent**.

## Continue as Email

Allows customers to continue a conversation by email. Toggle on in **Chatbox** → **Advanced** → **Continue as email**.

# WhatsApp & Messenger Issues

## WhatsApp Connection Requirements

**Plan note:** Connecting WhatsApp itself is available on **all plans, including
Free**. Only **AI auto-reply on WhatsApp** requires the **Pro** or **Plus** plan
(see `faq_ai-agent-settings` → *AI Channels*) — connection and manual/human replies
work on any plan.

The merchant needs all of the following:

1. **Meta Business Manager** — with **Business Admin** role (Employee role is NOT sufficient). Check at: business.facebook.com/settings/people
2. **Valid WhatsApp phone number** — not currently registered on WhatsApp personal app, OR an existing WhatsApp Business number migrated to Cloud API. OTP verification must be via SMS or phone call (not WhatsApp app). After the OTP step, number verification also includes a **PIN-code activation step** — the merchant must set/enter a PIN code to complete verification for the WhatsApp integration before the number becomes active
3. **Valid business information** — business name, type, legal address, website domain. Meta may require Business Verification for full features
4. **Correct permissions during OAuth** — must select Business Manager, WhatsApp Business Account, and phone number; grant "AVADA group company limited" permission
5. **Correct Facebook login** — must be added to Business Manager with proper permissions; browser must not block popups or third-party cookies
6. **No other WhatsApp API provider** — if the number is connected to another provider (Twilio, 360dialog, etc.), it must be released/migrated first

---

## WhatsApp Not Working After Connection

**Before troubleshooting, collect:**
- What role the connecting Facebook user has in Meta Business Manager (Admin or Employee?)
- Whether the phone number was previously connected to another WhatsApp API provider
- Whether Meta Business verification is complete or still pending
- What browser was used during OAuth setup

**Then check in order:**
1. **Insufficient permissions** — connecting user must be a Business Admin (not Employee) in Meta Business Manager. Ask merchant to verify at business.facebook.com/settings/people
2. **Phone number already in use** — ask merchant to confirm the number is not active on WhatsApp personal app and not connected to another API provider (Twilio, 360dialog, etc.)
3. **Business verification pending** — Meta requires verification for full features; ask merchant to check Meta Business Manager for any pending verification prompts
4. **Browser blocking popups** — if OAuth popup was blocked, ask merchant to try reconnecting in a different browser with popup blockers disabled

If all items check out but still not working → escalate with: store URL, phone number last 4 digits, Meta Business Manager ID, which items from the checklist were confirmed.

---

## Meta Business Account Phone-Number Limit Blocks a New Connection

If the merchant has confirmed **every item** on the checklists above (Business Admin role, number not in use elsewhere/not on another API provider, verification complete, no popup blockers) and the connection **still** fails or a new number can't be added, the cause may be **Meta's own cap on the number of phone numbers allowed per Business Account** — this is a Meta platform limit, not a Chatty setting, so nothing on Chatty's side can bypass it.

**Resolution:**
1. Ask the merchant to check **WhatsApp Manager** in Meta Business Suite for an existing, unused number already occupying a slot — freeing it up may resolve the block.
2. If no slot can be freed, the merchant needs to **request a higher phone-number capacity limit directly from Meta** (via Meta Business Suite / Meta support) — Chatty cannot request or grant this on the merchant's behalf.

---

## Messenger Messages Not Showing in Inbox

1. **Integration incomplete** — ensure all steps are completed in the Channels section
2. **Insufficient page permissions** — connecting user must have "Manage and access Page messages" permission. Check **Page Settings** → **Page Roles & Permissions**
3. **Permission deselection during setup** — if the merchant deselected items during Facebook OAuth, permissions may be incomplete
4. **Old messages** — only messages sent **after** Chatty is connected will sync. Old messages must be handled directly in Facebook Messenger

---

## Instagram Messages Not Showing

1. Verify Instagram channel is properly connected in **Chatty** → **Channels**
2. The connecting user must have admin access to the Facebook page
3. All permissions must have been granted during OAuth
4. Only new messages (sent after connection) will appear in Chatty

If all settings are correct but messages still don't sync → escalate with: store URL, Facebook page name/ID, when connection was made, screenshot of Channels settings showing Instagram is connected.

---

## WhatsApp Number Showing as Pending

Pending status means Meta verification is still in progress — typically takes 24–48 hours.

**Collect before advising:**
- When did the merchant connect WhatsApp? (if < 48 hours ago → just wait)
- Is the phone number registered with another WhatsApp Business API provider?
- Has the merchant completed Meta Business Verification?

**Guide the merchant to verify:**
1. Check that **WhatsApp Business account** is fully verified in Meta Business Manager
2. Confirm the phone number is **not** already registered with another API provider
3. Ensure **Two-factor authentication (2FA)** is enabled for the phone number in WhatsApp Business settings
4. Confirm the connecting user has the **Business Admin** role in Meta Business Manager (not Employee)
5. Confirm all permissions were granted to **"AVADA group company limited"** during OAuth, with no popup / cookie blockers active

If still Pending beyond 48 hours after all above are confirmed → escalate with: phone number last 4 digits, Meta Business Manager ID, when connection was made, screenshot of pending status.

---

## Switching WhatsApp BSP to Chatty

Meta policy allows a WhatsApp Business API number to be managed by **only one BSP at a time**. To switch to Chatty:
- Migrate the number (disconnect from current BSP and reconnect via Meta Business Manager), OR
- Create a new WhatsApp Business Account and associate the same phone number

Contact support for guidance on the migration process.

---

## AI for WhatsApp Without Website Widget

Yes — once WhatsApp is connected, go to **AI agent** → **Settings** and enable AI for the **WhatsApp channel**. The AI will respond to WhatsApp messages using the same training data as the website chatbox.

Access WhatsApp conversations via **Inbox** → **WhatsApp** tab.

---

## Outbound WhatsApp Messages

No — Chatty currently **only supports responding** within existing WhatsApp conversations. You cannot initiate new outbound WhatsApp messages to contacts who haven't messaged you first.

---

## Instagram Story Reply Errors

Chatty currently supports Instagram **text and image messages only**. Unsupported message types include: story replies, reel shares, voice messages/audio, stickers, post shares, and vanish mode messages.

The team is working on expanding support for these formats.

---

## Direct Replies Not Syncing to Chatty

Replies made directly in the Meta platform (not via Chatty) may not sync back to the Chatty inbox. This is a **known limitation** — a feature request has been filed to improve sync coverage for replies made outside of Chatty.

---

## AI Not Responding to Instagram

Go to **AI agent** → **Settings** and check if AI is enabled for the **Instagram channel** — there is a per-channel toggle.

Enable it and the AI will start responding automatically. Previously unhandled messages will continue to be assigned to agents by default until the toggle is on.

---

## Reply Fails on Messenger/Instagram — Meta's 24-Hour Window

Meta enforces a **24-hour messaging window**: if the customer's last message is more than 24 hours old, replies are blocked on their platform. This is Meta's own policy and **cannot be extended or bypassed from Chatty's side** — it isn't a Chatty bug.

Practical guidance for the merchant: reply within the window where possible, and capture the customer's email during the conversation as a fallback channel for anything needing a longer turnaround.

---

## WhatsApp Now Supports Images & Files

The **WhatsApp channel** in Chatty supports sending and receiving **images and files**, not just text — both merchants/staff replying from the Chatty inbox and the AI agent can send and receive media over WhatsApp, the same as on other channels (e.g. Instagram, Messenger). If a merchant reports they can't attach an image or file in a WhatsApp conversation, this is unexpected — collect a screenshot and escalate rather than telling them WhatsApp is text-only.

**WhatsApp media limits (agent-sent, as of 07/08):**
- **Images** — max **5MB**, **JPEG or PNG only** (other image formats are rejected on WhatsApp)
- **Video** — max **16MB**
- **Documents** — max **20MB**
- **Max 10 files per send**

**The 24-hour reply window still applies to files, same as text.** If the customer's last message is more than 24 hours old, the reply box locks and no file (or message) can be sent until the customer messages again — this is Meta's policy, not a Chatty limit (see *Reply Fails on Messenger/Instagram — Meta's 24-Hour Window* above, same rule applies to WhatsApp).

**Known fixed bug (14/08):** previously, ALL files sent by agents to customers via WhatsApp were being blocked by Meta regardless of size/type. This is now fixed — if a merchant reports old "file won't send on WhatsApp" behavior from before mid-August, have them retry; if it still fails, treat it as a new case and escalate with a screenshot rather than assuming it's the old known issue.

## WhatsApp Connection Flow Was Updated (31/07/2026)

As of **31 July 2026**, WhatsApp registration/connection in Chatty moved to a **new flow**; the **old step-by-step connection process is discontinued**. If a merchant is following older screenshots, guides, or prior support instructions and can't find the steps described there, that is **expected** — the flow changed, it is not a bug.

**Known gap:** the exact current click-by-click steps for the new flow are **not yet documented in this KB**. Do not invent or guess UI steps. If a merchant needs a precise walkthrough of the current WhatsApp connection flow, **escalate** the request so someone with the up-to-date flow can assist directly.
