## Embedded Signup Offers the Wrong WABA / Wrong Number

During WhatsApp connection, Meta's **Embedded Signup** sometimes offers a **different or newly-created WABA** (e.g. a US placeholder number) instead of the merchant's existing WhatsApp Business Account.

- Verify the correct **Business Portfolio** is selected during signup and that the desired number isn't already assigned elsewhere (personal WhatsApp app or another API provider).
- If the right WABA still can't be chosen, escalate with the **WABA ID, phone number, Business Manager ID, and a screenshot**.

## Instagram / Messenger Replies Arriving Delayed

Separate from messages not showing at all: Instagram/Messenger replies can sometimes arrive **significantly delayed** (e.g. an 11:12 message answered at 20:51). For persistent delays, flag it with the **page name/ID** so the team can investigate the channel connection.

# AI Data Sources

## AI Data Sources Overview

**Does Chatty automatically sync my shipping policy, About us, or other store pages?** Yes — Chatty auto-syncs these Shopify store pages with no manual re-sync needed: Shipping policy, Return policy, Privacy policy, Terms of service, FAQ, Contact us, and About us. If a merchant updates one of these pages, the AI picks up the change automatically. No action required.

Data sources are the information you provide to train your AI agent. The AI uses this data to give accurate, personalized responses about your products, services, and policies.

> **The four store sources start switched off.** Products, Collections, Discounts and FAQs are each
> synced into Chatty automatically — but the AI is **not allowed to use any of them until the store
> turns that source on** under **AI agent** → **Training data** → **Manage**. Syncing and using are
> two separate things, and only the syncing happens on its own.
>
> This is the single most common cause of *"the AI doesn't know my products"*, *"it makes answers
> up"*, or *"it says it can't find anything"*. Always check which sources are switched on before
> looking at anything else — a store can have thousands of products synced and an AI that is not
> permitted to read one of them.

**Store data (auto-synced):**
- Products: descriptions, variants, pricing, availability, inventory status, metafields
- Discounts: all active and inactive discounts from Shopify
- Markets: market settings including currency and exchange rates
- FAQs: your existing FAQs in Chatty

**Custom data sources (manually added):**
- Questions (Q&A pairs)
- URLs (website links — content is scraped and indexed)
- Files (.JSON, .TXT, .PDF, .CSV — max 2MB for AI training data; images and PDFs with tables not yet supported)

**Auto-synced Shopify pages:** Shipping policy, Return policy, Privacy policy, Terms of service, FAQ, Contact us, About us. These sync automatically — no manual action needed.

> **Fixed 17/08 — short Contact pages were being wrongly skipped.** Contact pages that are just a few lines plus an email address used to get treated as "empty" and excluded from the AI's knowledge, so the AI couldn't answer "how do I contact you" or state the shop's email even though the page existed and was synced. This is now fixed — short Contact pages are included. If a merchant reports the AI still can't state their contact email after this date, treat it as a new case (not the known short-page exclusion) and escalate with the store URL and the Contact page URL.

Product information updates daily at **00:00 UTC**. To sync sooner, trigger a manual resync in **AI agent → Training data → Products → Manage → Sync products**.

**What "product training" actually does:** Chatty simply **reads** the product data — title, description, price, variants — so the AI can answer questions about it. It does not modify, publish, or unpublish anything in the merchant's store.

---

## Adding & Managing Data Sources

Go to **AI agent** → **Training data**.

Training data is organized into 6 tabs:

- **Products** — enable/disable products for AI training, manage metafields, sync manually
- **Collections** — enable/disable collections; synced automatically with products
- **Discounts** — discount codes and automatic discounts from Shopify; auto sync daily
- **Markets** — market settings, currencies, exchange rates from Shopify
- **FAQs** — FAQ library managed in Chatty; AI answers from published FAQs
- **Custom knowledge** — add Q&As, URLs, or files:
  - **Questions** — add Q&A pairs (edit, change status Active/Inactive, delete)
  - **URLs** — add website links; content is scraped and indexed
  - **Files** — upload .JSON, .TXT, .PDF, or .CSV (max 2MB); images and PDFs with tables not yet supported

After adding data, click **Test AI** (top right) to verify AI responds correctly.

**Bulk management:** Select multiple items for bulk actions: set as active, set as inactive, or delete.

---

## Smart Recommendations Setup

Tell AI which products to recommend in specific situations:

1. Go to **AI agent** → **Instructions** → **Assistant skills** → **Product recommendations** → **Manage**
2. Select a collection to manage
3. Set up product list and keywords
4. Click **Add product** to add items, **Delete** to remove
5. Click **Save** and activate the recommendation

**System recommendations** (pre-configured, always available):
- **Best sellers** — AI suggests when customers ask "What's popular?" Enable **Activate smart syncing** to auto-select top products based on sales, or add products manually.
- **New arrivals** — AI suggests when customers ask "What's new?" Enable **Activate smart syncing** to auto-populate, or add products manually.

**Custom recommendations** (create your own):
- **Sale promotion** — triggers when customers mention "sale", "discount", "deal". Set search terms + product conditions (add by product or by collection).
- **Special occasions** — triggers when customers mention "gift", "birthday", "anniversary". Set search terms + product conditions.
- Click **Add recommendation** to create additional custom types.

---

## Managing Individual Products

After syncing products:
1. Go to **AI agent** → **Training data** → **Products** tab
2. Set each product's status to **Enabled** or **Disabled**

Only published, in-stock products work with Chatty. Product subscriptions are not supported.

**Add product-specific FAQs (AI training data):**
1. Click **Products** tab
2. Click **Add FAQs** or **Manage FAQs** on a specific product
3. Type each question and answer yourself

These FAQs teach the **AI agent** about that product — they are training data. Write them
manually; the AI-generate option produces FAQs for the store as a whole, not per product.

> To display a different set of FAQs on each **product page of the storefront**, this is the
> wrong tool. Use **FAQs** → **FAQs block**: create a block per product or group, select the
> questions, and set the display condition to **Product pages → by collection/tag**.
> See `faq_faqs-block`.

## Troubleshooting File & URL Training

- **CSV import shows questions as "Failed":** this is usually because the topic was set to **Published but not Active**. Set the topic **Active**, fix the file, and re-upload. If the app won't let you delete the failed rows, contact support to clear them.
- **Adding a website URL only trains the homepage:** entering the **domain alone** trains the AI on the homepage only. To train on specific content, add the **individual page URLs** (e.g. `/pages/avada-faqs`). The AI does **not** auto-scrape your whole site — you choose what to feed it.
- **File limits:** PDF, CSV, TXT, JSON, **max 2 MB each**; CSV is best for structured Q&A. Images and PDFs whose content is in tables/scans may not be parsed — re-enter that data as text.

# AI agent Settings

Configure your AI agent at **AI agent → Settings**. Use the **Test AI** button at
the top right to preview behavior without affecting live chat.

## Use Chatty as Human-Only Live Chat (Turn Off AI)

If a merchant wants to use Chatty as a pure human live chat tool with no AI involvement
at all, the answer is simple — **just deactivate the AI agent**. There is no need to
turn off AI channels one by one.

- **If the AI agent is on** → go to **AI agent** (in the app left menu), then click the
  **Deactivate** button at the top right of the page (next to Settings and Test AI).
  Once deactivated, all incoming conversations go straight to your inbox for your team
  to handle manually, and customers see no AI — the AI name and avatar only appear while
  the AI is actively responding.
- **If the AI agent was never activated** → just leave it **disabled** (the default).
  Nothing else needs to be done.

To turn AI back on later, click **Activate** on the same AI agent page.

## AI Identity

Customize the AI's name and avatar, shown to customers in conversations.
Path: **AI agent → Settings**.

- **Name**: The name shown to customers in the chatbox. Set it at
  **AI agent → Settings → Name**.
- **Avatar**: Choose a preset avatar, or upgrade to upload a custom image
- **Welcome message**: The first message customers see. Click **Insert customer name**
  to personalize it with the customer's name.

### Which "name" does the merchant mean? (three different fields)

Chatty has three separate name/identity fields. Identify which one the merchant is
pointing at before giving a path — a screenshot usually makes it obvious.

| What they want to change | Where it lives | What it affects |
|---|---|---|
| **AI agent name** — the name customers see when the AI replies | **AI agent → Settings → Name** | The AI's display name in the chatbox |
| **Team member / operator name** — the name on a human agent's profile | **Settings → Team → Manage** (edit the member) | The name customers see when a human replies |
| **Role / persona instructions** — how the AI describes itself and behaves | **AI agent → Instructions → Manage → General instructions → Role** | The AI's tone and self-description, **not** its display name |

**Common request — "make the AI introduce itself as our brand, not as an AI / not as
Chatty":** this is two settings working together.

1. Set the display name at **AI agent → Settings → Name** to the brand name.
2. Describe the persona at **AI agent → Instructions → Manage → General instructions →
   Role** (e.g. "You are the support assistant for BRAND").

Changing the Role text alone does **not** change the display name — the name field is
what customers see on the message.

### Which "welcome message" does the merchant mean? (three places, with override order)

The most common "I changed it but the old message still shows" case. There are three separate welcome messages, and the one that actually displays depends on setup — check in this order:

| Field | Where it lives | When it applies |
|---|---|---|
| **Chatbox welcome message** | **Chatbox → Chat page → Welcome Message** | Used only when the AI agent is **off** |
| **AI welcome message** | **AI agent → Settings → AI identity → Welcome message** | Used when the AI agent is **on** — overrides the chatbox one. Supports `{{customer_name}}` |
| **Translated welcome message** | **Settings → Translations → [language] → AI Agent / Live chat** | Each published language keeps its own copy — overrides **both** of the above for visitors in that language |

If the AI is enabled, the merchant needs to edit the **AI welcome message**. If they also have translations published, the translated copy is the most common reason an edit "doesn't take" — it must be updated separately. Note a separate **Proactive Chat** campaign message can also appear as a pop-up teaser; that one is edited in the **Proactive chat** section, not here.

**The AI welcome message is the same across every channel.** Website chat, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, and email all use the one AI welcome message (or, for a visitor in a published language, that language's translated version). There is **no setting to configure a different greeting per channel** — you cannot give WhatsApp a different opening line from the website widget. If a merchant wants a distinct greeting for one channel only, the only lever available today is language/translation, not channel; there is no per-channel override.

### "AI Not Using the Identity I Gave It"

If a merchant reports the AI isn't using the identity they configured, start at
**AI agent → Settings** and verify Name/Avatar/Welcome message are saved, and check
**Instructions → General instructions → Role** for the persona text. Don't default
to the generic data-source/Instructions-saved troubleshooting used for wrong-answer
cases (see `case_ai-wrong-responses` → *AI Reverts to Default Behavior*) — that flow
is for factual answers, not identity/persona.

## Support Email Addresses

Set a **Contact support email**. The customer contact form and chat history are
sent to this address. Separate multiple emails with commas (,).

## AI Availability — Control When AI Replies

Control when the AI agent replies to customers, based on your team's availability.

Go to **AI agent → Settings → AI availability → Choose when AI replies**, then pick:

- **Always** — AI replies anytime, even when agents are online
- **Only when agents are offline** — AI replies only when no human agents are online

Manage your team's hours in **Chat availability settings**.

## AI Re-engagement

**AI re-engage after resolution**: When enabled, resolved conversations are reopened
and reassigned to the AI when a customer sends a new message. Respects your AI
availability setting.

## Follow-up Messages

**AI Follow-up**: Automatically sends a follow-up when a customer goes silent during
a conversation, helping recover distracted shoppers.

- **Wait time**: How long to wait after the customer's last message before sending a
  follow-up. Choose from a dropdown: **3 minutes**, **5 minutes (recommended)**,
  **10 minutes**, or **15 minutes** (default: 5 minutes).

## AI Channels

**Out of the box the AI only answers on the online store chat widget.** Every other channel starts
switched off, even after it has been connected successfully. Connecting WhatsApp, Messenger,
Instagram or Email brings the messages into the Inbox, but the AI stays silent on them until that
channel is turned on here as well.

This is the usual explanation for *"the AI replies on my website but not on WhatsApp/Messenger/email"* —
the channel is connected, it just was never added to the list the AI is allowed to answer on. Check
this before treating it as a fault.

Enable the **AI agent to reply** on selected channels: **Email**, **Messenger**,
**Instagram**, and **WhatsApp**. Click **Connect** on each channel to set it up.

The **Pro/Plus** plan gate applies to **AI auto-reply on that channel** — not to
connecting the channel itself. Connecting WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, or Email
is available on **all plans, including Free**; only having the AI respond
automatically on WhatsApp, Messenger, or Instagram requires **Pro or Plus** (see
`case_whatsapp-messenger-issues` and `faq_channels`).

## Embed Product AI Agent

**AI product assistant**: Configure how your AI agent behaves and responds to customer
questions about your products, embedded on your product pages. Use **Go to theme** to
add it (this enables the theme app embed — it does NOT open cart settings). Available
on the **Pro** and **Plus** plans.

Note: there is no separate "Add-to-Cart" toggle or setting. Adding items to the cart is
automatic behavior of the AI product assistant — the AI adds an item when a customer
asks in chat. If a merchant reports the AI isn't adding items to cart, treat it as a
support case (theme compatibility / variant issue), not a setting to enable — see
kb_ai-wrong-responses.

## AI Personalization Using Shopify Customer Tags

The AI agent can read a **logged-in customer's Shopify customer tags** (e.g. "VIP", "wholesale") to personalize its replies — for example, adjusting tone or offers for a tagged VIP customer. This works automatically for identified/logged-in customers; it has no separate on/off toggle and needs no setup beyond having the tags applied in Shopify. Anonymous/guest visitors have no customer tags for the AI to read.

## Embed Homepage AI Agent

**AI agent on Homepage**: Embed the AI chat widget on your homepage so customers can
ask about your store, find products, and get instant AI responses. Use **Go to theme**
to add it. Available on the **Pro** and **Plus** plans.

# Chatbox Settings & Customization

## Chatbox Not Showing on Store

Check these two things:

1. **App Embed enabled** — Go to **Shopify Admin** → **Online Store** → **Themes** → **Customize** → **App Embeds**. Make sure Chatty is toggled **ON** and saved.

2. **Chatbox and Live chat enabled** — In Chatty, go to **Chatbox** → **General**. Turn on **Display chatbox on your store**, then under **Blocks** turn on **Live chat**.

After confirming both, reload the storefront. If it still doesn't appear, follow the collaborator access flow: ask the merchant's permission, collect their collaborator code (**Shopify Admin → Settings → Users and permissions → Security → Collaborator request code**), and escalate to the TS team with the store URL and issue details.

> **Do not confuse these controls:** **Display chatbox on your store** controls widget visibility; the **Live chat** block enables the chat feature; **Settings → Working hours → Chat status** only shows/hides the online/offline status line.

---

## Chatbox Customization Overview

**General tab** (**Chatbox** → **General**):
- **Embed app to your theme** — button to enable App Embed in Shopify theme editor
- **Display chatbox on your store** — master toggle to show/hide chatbox
- **Chat focus mode** — automatically opens to chat page when chatbox is opened (only active when Live chat is enabled)
- **Header** — upload logo, set heading and description
- **Blocks** — toggle on/off: Live chat, Contact, Order tracking, FAQs, Categories

**Chat page tab** (**Chatbox** → **Chat page**):
- **Welcome message** — message sent when customer initiates chat; option to use different offline message
- **Conversation starter** — toggle on/off; pre-set Q&A shortcuts shown to customers
- **Chat avatar** — Store branding (logo) or Team member profile
- **Pre-chat form** — how customers start a chat: Chat as guest (info required), Chat as anonymous (no info), or Show both options; fields: email (required), phone (optional); marketing opt-in toggle; Disclaimer consent

**Appearance tab** (**Chatbox** → **Appearance**):
- **Brand colors** — presets (Cloud, Midnight, Volcano, Amethyst, etc.) or Custom; "Surprise me" randomizer; **Auto-detect brand color** — automatically identifies the store's brand color instead of picking a preset or custom color manually
- **Chatbox button** — Launcher type (Icon only / Label only / Icon & label), Button icon, Button size (Small/Medium/Large), and **Position** — drag the dot to place the button, or pick a corner **Anchor** (e.g. Bottom right) and fine-tune **Horizontal offset** and **Vertical offset** (0–45%)
- **Chatbox style** — display style (No navigation / Show navigation), Mobile ratio (Full-screen / 90% / 80%)

**Advanced tab** (**Chatbox** → **Advanced**):
- **Embedded chatbox** — embed chatbox as a section on any store page via theme editor
- **Deep links** — copy links to open specific sections: `#chatty-home`, `#chatty-chat`, `#chatty-tracking`, `#chatty-help`
- **Display settings** — Display devices (All / Desktop only / Mobile only); Display pages (Show on all / Show on specific / Hide on specific pages)
- **Continue as email** — allow customers to continue conversations by email
- **Custom CSS** — add custom CSS for advanced customization

---

## Showing FAQs Without Categories in the Chatbox

To show the questions in the chatbox as a plain list, without the category groupings, go to
**Chatbox** → **General** → **Blocks** and turn the **Categories** block **off**. The **FAQs**
block stays on, so customers still see the questions.

> This controls the chatbox only. The "Don't categorize FAQs" option in **FAQs → FAQs block**
> is a separate setting that affects FAQs blocks embedded on storefront pages.

## Changing the Welcome Message

Go to **Chatbox** → **Chat page** → **Welcome Message** to customize the greeting text. Changes take effect immediately after saving.

If using the AI agent, go to **AI agent** → **Settings** → **AI identity** → **Welcome message** to customize the AI's greeting separately. You can also insert the customer's name using the `{{customer_name}}` variable.

**"I've run out of room" / the field won't let me type more:** the welcome and offline message fields have a **300-character limit** — this is different from the Instructions cap (raisable, see `faq_ai-training-setup.md`) and the Custom Scenario cap (also fixed). If a merchant needs more room, keep the greeting short and move longer explanations into the AI's training data so it can deliver detail conversationally, or use the **First auto-reply (Offline)** message under **Settings → General → Chat availability → Manage** for offline context.

---

## Adjusting Widget Position

Chatty now has a **built-in Position control** — no Custom CSS needed for most cases. Go to **Chatbox** → **Appearance** → **Chatbox button** → **Position**:

1. **Drag the dot** to choose where the widget button sits, **or**
2. Pick a corner **Anchor** (Bottom right, Bottom left, etc.) and fine-tune the **Horizontal offset** and **Vertical offset** (each adjustable 0–45%)

This lets merchants move the widget higher, lower, or sideways to avoid overlapping other elements. To hide the widget on specific pages instead, go to **Chatbox** → **Advanced** → **Display settings** → **Display pages**.

> **Note:** Use the **Position** control (Appearance → Chatbox button) for standard repositioning. Custom CSS via **Chatbox** → **Advanced** → **Custom CSS** is only needed for advanced cases the offset range can't cover (e.g. dynamic hiding when a cart drawer opens, or moving beyond the 45% offset limit).

---

## Changing Chatbox Colors & Appearance

Go to **Chatbox** → **Appearance** to customize: primary color, background color, and text color. Use pre-built presets for quick selection, or the **"Surprise me"** option to randomize.

There's also an **auto-detect brand color** option, which automatically picks up the store's brand color instead of the merchant choosing a preset or custom color by hand — useful for merchants who want the chatbox to match their store without manually finding the right hex value.

For advanced customization (font size, spacing), use **Custom CSS** under **Chatbox** → **Advanced**. Preview changes in real-time before saving.

---

## Setting Up Conversation Starters

Conversation Starters are clickable shortcut buttons (also called quick-access FAQ buttons) that appear when a customer opens the chatbox, letting them quickly ask common questions or jump to FAQ topics.

1. Go to **Chatbox** → **Chat page** → **Conversation Starters**
2. Click **Add Starter** and enter the question text

You can add up to 4–6 starters. Link each starter to a specific AI scenario for consistent responses.

> **Do not confuse these controls:** **Conversation Starters** and **FAQs** are two separate lists that do not sync in either direction. Editing an FAQ's answer does **not** update a Conversation Starter that asks the same question, and importing a starter from an FAQ is a **one-time copy**, not a live link. If a merchant edits an FAQ and expects the matching starter to update automatically, explain this and manually copy the new answer text into the Conversation Starter yourself.

**Importing an FAQ as a starter:** merchants can import an existing FAQ directly as a Conversation Starter from within the **AI Assistant** setup area, instead of typing the starter text manually. This is a real, shipped feature — but remember it only copies the FAQ's current answer once at import time (see the sync note above), so later edits to the FAQ still need to be copied over manually.

---

## Hide Widget When Cart Drawer Opens

1. Go to **Chatbox** → **Advanced** → **Display settings** → **Display pages** → **Hide on specific pages** to hide on specific pages
2. For dynamic hiding (e.g. when cart drawer opens), go to **Chatbox** → **Advanced** → **Custom CSS** and add a custom CSS rule

Alternatively, add custom JavaScript in your theme to detect when the cart drawer opens and dispatch a Chatty hide event. Contact support for the exact code snippet for your specific theme.

---

## Disabling Add-to-Cart / Cart Showing Empty

**To remove the cart feature:** The cart section and the AI's Add-to-Cart feature can be removed on request — the tech team disables them (useful when a merchant wants the widget as a pure FAQ/support tool). Collect the store URL and forward to the team.

**Cart shows empty after the AI adds items:** The AI does add items correctly, but some custom themes (custom cart drawers / non-standard Ajax carts) don't follow Shopify's standard cart behavior, so the drawer needs a refresh to reflect the change. The fix is for the team to add the `chatty:cart:changed` event to the theme.

To apply it, ask the merchant to grant collaborator access: **Shopify Settings → Users → Security → Collaborator request code**, then escalate to the team with the store URL and the code.

---

## Chatbox Opening Automatically

1. Go to **Chatbox** → **General**
2. Toggle off **Chat focus mode** (note: this setting is only active when Live chat is enabled)

If the chatbox still opens on load, check if any **Proactive Chat** campaigns are configured to trigger immediately on page load and disable them in **Proactive Chat** settings.

If neither is the cause, check for an **Embedded chatbox section** placed directly in the theme (as a page section rather than the floating widget) — a section placed this way renders open by design. Remove or reposition the section in the theme editor.

---

## Chatty Script Loading on Every Page (PageSpeed)

Turning off individual features (e.g. the FAQ page) reduces what's rendered, but the widget script itself still loads wherever the **App Embed** is active, since that's what makes the chatbox available at all. Restricting the widget to specific pages under **Chatbox → Advanced → Display settings → Display pages** is the most effective control available today.

Lazy-loading the script until a visitor interacts isn't currently configurable — logged as a feature request, along with the related cookie-consent/deferred-load request.

---

## Adding a Phone/Call Button

Go to **Chatbox** → **General** → **Blocks** → **Contact** → **Edit** to configure contact options including phone.

> **Note:** There is no separate "Channels" section in Chatty. Phone contact is configured via the Contact block.

---

## Changing the Online/Offline Status Message

The status message shows customers whether your team is available (e.g. "We are
online") or away (e.g. "Usually reply in a few minutes").

To edit it, go to **Settings** → **Working hours**. Turn on **Chat status**, then edit:

- **Online status** — text shown when an agent is available (e.g. "We are online")
- **Offline status** — text shown when no agent is available (e.g. "Usually reply in a few minutes")

Use **Online status display** on the same page to decide whether working hours, agent
availability, or both determine the storefront status. There is a 3rd option here (added **07/07**):
**"Show online only when staff is on duty"** — with this selected, the widget shows the offline
status whenever no agent is actually on duty, even if it's within business hours. **The AI still
replies as normal in this mode** — only the storefront status label goes offline, chat itself is not
disabled. If a merchant on this setting asks "is the AI down when the widget shows offline?", the
answer is no. **First auto-reply** is a separate section: its Online message and Offline message
are the first automatic chat reply, not the status label.

---

## Resizing the Chat Bubble

Go to **Chatbox** → **Appearance** to adjust the icon size and style.

For a percentage-based resize (e.g., reduce to 60%), a custom CSS code can be added via **Chatbox** → **Advanced** → **Custom CSS**. Contact support to help apply this.

---

## Embedding Chat Widget in a Page

Go to **Chatbox** → **Advanced** → **Embedded chatbox** → click **Go to theme** to embed as a section on any store page.

Note: embedding a fully functional AI chat widget into a Hero Banner or homepage section is in development. For now, the embedded option works within page content sections.

---

## Disabling "View Similar" Button

Currently there is **no on/off toggle** for this button in settings.

Contact support — the team can hide it using custom CSS via **Chatbox** → **Advanced** → **Custom CSS**.

---

## Removing the "Typing… / Query…" Status Text

While the AI is preparing an answer it shows a short status text (e.g. *"typing…"*, *"query…"*) above the three-dot indicator.

This can be removed with **custom CSS** via **Chatbox** → **Advanced** → **Custom CSS**.

If the merchant wants to keep the animated **three-dot indicator** but drop the wording, contact support — the team can add a small CSS snippet that hides only the status text.

---

## Away Mode

Away mode allows individual team members to appear offline to customers without logging out. When enabled:
- The storefront shows that staff member as unavailable
- If **all** staff have Away mode on, customers see the store as offline
- Resets automatically when the member logs out and back in

Activate it via the toggle at the top of the Chatty app interface.

**Team shows "offline" even though a member is logged in:** this is almost always **Away mode** on that member — turn it off so they show online to customers. Two related points merchants ask about:
- **Online/offline status only works when the Live chat block is on** in Chatbox settings, and working hours are set in **Settings** → **General** → **Chat availability**.
- **To be alerted to a new live chat, the agent must allow browser notifications from Chatty** in their browser (see notification troubleshooting if alerts don't arrive). Agents log in at **app.chatty.net** — no Shopify admin needed; they accept the invite email and set a password first.

---

## Unread Message Counter

A red number on the chat button shows visitors how many unread or welcome messages are waiting.

If you turn on Proactive Chat (Welcome teaser in Automation), those messages also count as unread.

## Pre-Chat Form

The chatbox can ask for a customer's details (name/email) before or during a chat. Three modes:
**required**, **optional**, or **off**.

**The form no longer blocks customers from chatting.** Even when the form is set to ask for
details, customers can continue asking questions and using the chat without filling it in first —
the form does not gate access to the conversation. This resolves what used to be a common
complaint ("customers being blocked from chatting" or a drop in conversations right after
install caused by the form requiring an email up front); if a merchant reports that old
behavior, let them know it no longer blocks chatting.

The store also chooses who is allowed to start a chat: as a **guest** (leaves contact details), as
**anonymous** (leaves nothing), or **both** — and both is the default.

Use the required/optional/off setting to control how much the form nudges customers to leave
contact details, not to control whether they can chat — that's no longer tied together.

---

## Message and Attachment Limits

- **One message can be up to 10,000 characters.** Long pasted content gets cut at that point.
- **Files customers and agents can send in chat:** images (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, SVG), PDF, Word
  documents, video, and compressed archives.
- **Spreadsheets cannot be sent in chat** — Excel and similar files are rejected. Ask for a PDF or a
  screenshot instead. This is the answer when someone reports "my file won't upload"; the file is
  almost always a spreadsheet.
- **On Messenger the list is narrower still** — only images, PDF and Word go through. Video and
  archives do not, and that restriction comes from Meta, not from Chatty.

---

## Open Straight Into Chat (Skip Home / Pre-Chat Screen)

To make the chatbox open directly into the AI chat so customers can type right away, combine these:

1. **Chat focus mode** — turn it on so the chatbox opens straight to the chat page (only active when Live chat is enabled).
2. **Pre-chat form** — if customers are asked for name/email before they can type, turn the form off (or allow **Chat as anonymous**) so they reach the AI immediately.
3. **Conversation starters** — trim or remove them under Chatbox settings for a cleaner open.
4. Make sure the **Live chat / AI block is enabled** so the message box actually appears (a common cause of "no option to type" is the block being off or a display style mid-change).

For a minimal layout beyond these built-in controls, share a screenshot and TS can advise on Custom CSS.

# AI Performing Real Actions (Shipping Address Change & Email Subscription)

## Overview

As of **13/08**, the AI agent can perform two real actions on a customer's behalf, not just answer questions:

1. **Change shipping address** — only for orders that have **not yet shipped**.
2. **Update email subscription** — opt a customer in or out of marketing emails.

This is **off by default**. A merchant must explicitly enable it at **AI agent → Instructions → Skills**.

## Guardrails (Important for Troubleshooting/Trust Questions)

- **The AI only acts after an explicit customer confirmation** in the immediately prior message — it never changes an address or subscription on its own initiative mid-conversation.
- **The AI must match the request to the correct order** before acting:
  - A **logged-in customer** is auto-matched to their own orders.
  - A **guest** must provide the **exact email or phone number** on the order.
  - If there's no match, the AI **refuses the action and reveals nothing** about the order (no partial info leak).
- **Shipped or cancelled orders cannot be changed.** If a customer asks to change the address on an order that already shipped, the AI explains this and offers a **human handover** instead of attempting the change.
- **Order cancellation via AI is NOT supported yet.** If a merchant or customer asks whether the AI can cancel an order, tell them this specific action isn't available yet — don't imply it's coming or promise a timeline.

## Common Questions

**"A customer says the AI changed their shipping address — is that real / can I trust it?"**
Yes, this is expected if the merchant has this skill enabled. Verify: was the order unshipped at the time, and did the customer explicitly confirm the change in the message right before it was applied? Both should be true given the guardrails above.

**"Can I turn this off?"**
Yes — it's opt-in per store at **AI agent → Instructions → Skills**. A merchant who doesn't want the AI taking these actions can leave it off (the default) or disable it if previously turned on.

**"A guest asked the AI to change their address but it refused"**
Expected if they didn't supply the exact email/phone on the order — this is the guardrail working as intended, not a bug. Ask the merchant to confirm the guest provided matching contact info.

**"Can the AI cancel an order?"**
No — not supported. Only shipping-address change (unshipped orders) and email subscription opt in/out are available today.
